title: UK CPI, March 2027 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the quiet endpoint of the electricity-VAT step, and the print where Easter is actually predictable
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationukmarch2027, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 42,072 bytes) — the ONS release page reads 'Consumer price inflation, UK: March 2027', 'Provisional release date: 21 April 2027 7:00am', 'This release is not yet published', and carries the UK Statistics Authority accredited-official-statistics kitemark. That is 07:00 London / 02:00 ET, a Wednesday, consistent with ONS's standing CPI slot. ONS's own label is Provisional, which is the honest reason for `estimate` on top of the standing schema gap: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics, and this lane may not self-confirm. Re-verified independently of BOTH proposing lanes during the never-assessed initial research of this event, 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-09, superseding proposals/uk-cpi-2027-04-21.from-uk-cpi-2027-05-19.json and proposals/uk-cpi-2027-04-21.from-boe-decision-2027-04-29.json (both read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md). Both proposals' placement findings stand: this is the LAST month inside the SI 2026/987 zero-rate window (art. 1(2), read direct on legislation.gov.uk today: effect 'in relation to supplies made in the period beginning with 1st October 2026 and ending with 31st March 2027'), and it sits eight days before the 2027-04-29 MPC + Monetary Policy Report. WHAT THE INITIAL RESEARCH ADDED. FIRST, THE ENDPOINT NOISE IS ASYMMETRIC ABOUT 29:1, WHICH RE-POINTS THE ENTRY: the sibling lane established the ~0.098pp VAT step is unreadable in an APRIL headline; measured from this side, March is the 3rd QUIETEST of twelve months on the year-on-year step (mean absolute 0.218pp, D7G7 2010-2026) against April's 0.594pp, the noisiest, and the electricity index itself (D7DT) moved exactly +0.00% m/m in SIX OF EIGHT price-cap-era Marches (mean +0.031%, largest 0.30%) because the Ofgem cap does not reset in March. At the 2026 weight CJXA 20.6065/1000 the worst March move on record is 0.006pp of headline, ONE SIXTEENTH of the VAT step, against April's median absolute cap move of 8.79%. So this print is an ANCHOR, not a second thing to model — recorded, not decomposed. Registered as FT-uk-cpi-2027-04-21-1 at a +/-1.0% threshold, over 3x the largest move in the sample. SECOND, IT CORRECTS A SIBLING'S GRADE: uk-cpi-2027-05-19 graded the Easter confound MIXED because 'the two nearest analogues disagree in sign' (April air fares 2016 -14.3%, 2024 +6.5%). They do not disagree — they sit on one line four days apart. Regressing the APRIL-MINUS-MARCH swing in D7EH on Easter Sunday's distance from 1 March, 2001-2026: slope +1.543pp/day, r = 0.856, R2 = 0.732, n = 26, residual sd 8.13pp. Easter moves the spike BETWEEN the two months and its date says which; fitted for 2027's 28 March Easter the swing is -13.1pp, i.e. the spike lands in THIS print. Every year with Easter on or before 28 March is 3 for 3 in both months (March +5.41/+8.51/+22.93%; April -7.14/-4.70/-14.29%), and 2024 — the one late-March year whose spike landed in April — is exactly what the slope predicts. Registered as FT-uk-cpi-2027-04-21-2 at >= +5.0% m/m: 83% power, 25% false-positive on 2001-2026. THE HONEST HALF SUSTAINS THE SIBLING BY A BETTER ROUTE: the same regression at the HEADLINE collapses to R2 0.250, residual sd 0.33pp, fitted -0.06pp — same order as the +0.098pp VAT step, opposite sign, and swamped 3.4x by the residual. Item-level modelable; headline-level not. THIRD, THE MPR CLAIM HAS RIGHT DATES ROUND A WRONG CONCEPT: the boe-decision-2027-04-29 proposal reads the 15-working-day conditioning window as a data cut-off. It is not — the Bank's own April 2026 Report footnotes market-implied policy-rate curves 'estimated based on the 15 UK working days to 22 April 2026' and conditions energy on 'market futures curves' over the same window, while using a separate phrase, 'data cut-off', for statistical inputs. Whether the MPC has SEEN this print is not in doubt at eight days out; what the window decides is whether this print's MARKET REACTION enters the average at 1/15 = 6.7% weight (8-day analogue, window closes 2027-04-21) or not at all (10-day analogue, closes 2027-04-19). Published gaps verified direct: Feb-2026 10 days, Apr-2026 8 days, Jul-2026 10 days. The April 2027 Report's own footnote settles FT-boe-decision-2027-04-29-1. FOURTH, THE COMMITTEE SEES TWO PRINTS, NOT ONE: ONS Feb-2027 CPI publishes 2027-03-24 (Provisional, verified today), six days AFTER the 2027-03-18 MPC (BoE 2027 provisional dates, verified today) — so the 2027-04-29 committee receives 24 March and 21 April. Neither contains post-lapse data, which makes the proposals' second point stronger than they stated, not weaker. Both dates were absent from the calendar and are proposed in this PR. NAMED OPEN UNCERTAINTY, NOT A FINDING: the SI binds 'supplies MADE' in the window, but a continuous supply's VAT tax point is normally the earlier of invoice or payment, so April billing of March consumption could straddle the boundary; whether that smears the step across the two indices depends on whether ONS collects a published tariff rate or a modelled bill, and the ONS technical-manual page was not located (two guessed URLs, both 404 — an author error, not a blocked source, so nothing is recorded in probe-ref.blocked). It resolves on ONS's April 2027 commentary and it is what FT-...-1 would catch. CORRIDOR: only three tracked events within five days — this is a 02:00 ET print on VIX-EXPIRATION MORNING (vix-expiration-2027-04-21), inside the FOMC blackout (from 2027-04-17) ahead of fomc-2027-04-28, five days after opex-2027-04-16; for a book of eight US mega-caps the session belongs to the settle and the blackout. Tiered LOW: symbols: [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar, and no rates- or FX-keyed house playbook. DATA VINTAGE STATED: every MM23 series fetched today ends at May 2026. THE VAT CONTENT IS CONTINGENT on the 2027-03-31 lapse (FT-uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01-1, score by 2027-03-31); if the zero rate is extended or SI 2026/987 annulled (laid 8 September 2026, so the praying period closes ~2026-10-18), this print keeps its date and loses its subject — the Easter and corridor findings survive either way, the anchor findings become moot. Proposed onto the calendar in the same PR, both primary-verified 2026-09-09: uk-cpi-2027-03-24 (the February print, the other one the April committee sees) and boe-decision-2027-03-18 (the MPC immediately before).
